title: Rose & geranium coconut wax votive
subtitle: A small floral candle for votives and votive holders
excerpt: A coconut wax votive candle scented with rose and geranium essential oils. Votive candles are designed to burn entirely inside a votive holder; without the holder the wax pool spreads. The rose-geranium combination gives a rounded floral scent with a rosy top note and a leafy green back. Makes four votives; each burns for around 10 hours.
sourceNotes: Votive candle method: poured in a cylindrical mould and burned inside a votive holder. Coconut wax: melt point 45-50°C; pour temperature 50-55°C for votive moulds. Rose and geranium EO blend: geranium (Pelargonium graveolens) EO at 60% + rose absolute 40% gives a rose-forward floral without the cost of pure rose absolute. Fragrance load 6% of wax weight for EO blends in coconut wax. Geranium EO is generally safe for adults; avoid in pregnancy at high concentrations.

recipe.yieldDescription: 4 votive candles (~45 g each; ~10-hour burn time each)
recipe.batchNotes: Scales cleanly. Votive moulds are small, if you have 8 moulds you can double the batch in a single pour session.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Allow 2 hours minimum before unmoulding, 24 hours for a full cure. Votives can be made weeks ahead.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Effectively indefinite. Store in a cool place, coconut wax softens in warm conditions. The rose-geranium scent is strongest in the first 12 months.

glossaryTerms.definition: The temperature at which melted wax is poured into the mould. Coconut wax pours at 50-55°C, lower than soy because its melt point is lower. Pouring hotter causes excess shrinkage as the wax cools.

content.text: Rose and geranium coconut wax votive is a small candle poured into a cylindrical votive mould and designed to burn completely inside a glass or metal votive holder. The rose-geranium essential oil blend gives a rounded floral scent, the geranium carries the main character, close to rose but leafier and less sweet. Coconut wax holds essential oils well and burns slowly. Four votives; each burns for around 10 hours.
Geranium essential oil is safe for most adults. Use with care during pregnancy. The amount used in these votives falls within normal home-use levels.

items.prepNote: votive/pillar grade; melt point 45-50°C; pour at 50-55°C
Pelargonium graveolens; 60% of essential oil blend; 3.6% of wax weight
rose absolute or rose fragrance oil; 40% of blend; 2.4% of wax weight
pre-tabbed wicks for votive moulds; one per votive

content.text: Thread a wick through each votive mould and seat the tab at the base. Lay a pencil or skewer across the top of each mould to hold the wick centred.
Melt the coconut wax over a simmering-water bath to 60°C. Watch it, never leave melting wax unattended.
Pour into the four votive moulds. Leave undisturbed for 2 hours to set, then unmould. Trim wicks to 3 mm before use.
Store in a cool place; coconut wax softens above 45°C. The floral scent is strongest in the first year. The wax does not deteriorate.
